items.role: Interim President and Chief Executive Officer
items.date_raw: July 9, 2026 announcement; effective July 13, 2026
items.citation_text: ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Interim President and CEO appointed → Following a period of executive transition, the Board appointed Pierre Noel as Interim President and Chief Executive Officer, effective July 13, 2026. Noel had previously led Pembroke Regional Hospital and had subsequently served as interim CEO at The Royal Ottawa Mental Health Centre and Renfrew Victoria Hospital. ARH said he would provide stability and continuity while the Board recruited a permanent President and CEO. → July 9, 2026 announcement; effective July 13, 2026 → Arnprior Regional Health → ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO

items.date_raw: Acknowledged July 9, 2026; exact acting-period start not stated
items.citation_text: ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Acting President and CEO assignment concluded → ARH acknowledged that Raeline McGrath, Vice President of Patient Care and Chief Nursing Executive, had served as Acting President and CEO “during the few weeks” before Pierre Noel’s appointment. The announcement does not provide an exact start date for McGrath’s acting assignment, so the period cannot be dated more precisely from the public statement. → Acknowledged July 9, 2026; exact acting-period start not stated → Arnprior Regional Health → ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO

items.date_raw: June 2, 2026
items.citation_text: Public Statement on Jeremy Stevenson's departure
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → President and CEO stepped down → Jeremy Stevenson stepped down as President and CEO on June 2, 2026. ARH’s public statement thanked him for his service and cited his work advancing the organization’s strategic goals and the regional Epic electronic medical record initiative. The statement did not disclose a reason for his departure. → June 2, 2026 → Arnprior Regional Health → Public Statement on Jeremy Stevenson’s departure

items.date_raw: June 27, 2025 announcement; effective August 1, 2025
items.citation_text: ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Chief of Staff transition to joint hospital model → ARH and Queensway Carleton Hospital announced that QCH Chief of Staff Dr. Kathi Kovacs would also become ARH’s Chief of Staff under a joint model. ARH described the arrangement as a way to share the cost of medical leadership and strengthen clinical links between the two hospitals. → June 27, 2025 announcement; effective August 1, 2025 → Arnprior Regional Health and Queensway Carleton Hospital → ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff

items.date_raw: June 27, 2025 announcement; leadership transition effective August 1, 2025
items.citation_text: ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Chief of Staff tenure concluded → The joint Chief of Staff announcement confirmed that Dr. Florin Padeanu, who had served as ARH Chief of Staff since 2022, would leave that leadership role when Dr. Kathi Kovacs began. ARH stated that Padeanu would continue caring for patients through the Tall Pines Clinic and as a hospitalist physician on ARH’s Inpatient Unit. → June 27, 2025 announcement; leadership transition effective August 1, 2025 → Arnprior Regional Health → ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff

items.citation_text: ARH Board of Directors Appoints New Chair

items.date_raw: May 10, 2024 announcement; start date August 18, 2024
items.citation_text: Board announces new CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → New President and CEO selected → The Board appointed Jeremy Stevenson as the next President and CEO following a competitive recruitment process. Stevenson was then CEO of St. Joseph’s General Hospital Elliot Lake and had previously held executive roles at the North East LHIN, Mattawa Hospital and Algonquin Nursing Home, St. Francis Memorial Hospital and Renfrew Victoria Hospital. ARH stated that he would join the organization on August 18, 2024. → May 10, 2024 announcement; start date August 18, 2024 → Arnprior Regional Health → Board announces new CEO

items.date_raw: December 7, 2023 announcement; retirement in late June 2024
items.citation_text: Leah Levesque to Retire June 2024
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → President and CEO retirement announced → Leah Levesque advised the Board that she intended to retire in late June 2024. The Board said it would begin a comprehensive search for her successor. ARH later described her as its “newly retired CEO” in the July 2024 Board Chair announcement, confirming that the retirement had occurred, although the publicly retrieved announcement gives only “late June” rather than an exact final working date. → December 7, 2023 announcement; retirement in late June 2024 → Arnprior Regional Health → Leah Levesque to Retire June 2024

items.citation_text: Special Meeting of the Board following the 2023 AGM
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → New directors elected → At the special Board meeting following the 2023 AGM, ARH welcomed three newly elected directors: Borys Koba, Rick Holock and Pete Kenny. The minutes state that the new directors had begun orientation and would be assigned mentors based on their committee assignments. → June 22, 2023 → Arnprior Regional Health Board minutes → Special Meeting of the Board following the 2023 AGM

items.date_raw: Transition documented February 17, 2022; exact Padeanu appointment date not found
items.citation_text: February 17, 2022 Board minutes and ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Chief of Staff transition documented → February 2022 Board minutes thanked Dr. Christine Schriver for her work as the former ARH Chief of Staff. Later ARH reporting states that Dr. Florin Padeanu served as Chief of Staff from 2022, but the publicly retrieved sources do not specify Padeanu’s exact appointment date. items.date_raw: August 19, 2021 announcement; Hanna retired September 30 and Levesque started October 1, 2021
items.citation_text: Arnprior Regional Health will welcome new President and CEO this fall
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → New President and CEO appointed; outgoing CEO retirement → The Board appointed Leah Levesque as President and CEO, effective October 1, 2021. She succeeded Eric Hanna, who retired on September 30, 2021 after 13 years leading ARH. Levesque returned to the organization from Queensway Carleton Hospital and had previously spent six years in senior leadership at ARH as Vice President of Patient and Resident Care and Chief Nursing Executive. → August 19, 2021 announcement; Hanna retired September 30 and Levesque started October 1, 2021 → Arnprior Regional Health → Arnprior Regional Health will welcome new President and CEO this fall
